title: neillia sinensis var. duclouxii
intro: Neillia sinensis var. duclouxii, commonly known as Ducloux's neillia, is a plant species that belongs to the family Rosaceae. It is traditionally used in Chinese medicine for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Ducloux's neillia include reducing fever, relieving pain and swelling, and improving cardiovascular health. The bioactive constituents of Ducloux's neillia include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
